questions: Which two scenes show why indoor drying is difficult?
Where do people dry clothes during long rainy periods?
Is a crowded balcony or indoor dampness worse?
Why do clothes dry slowly during monsoon?
If clothes stay indoors every day, what other problem appears?
What could you try in 14 days for at most 6,000 BDT? Who might pay if it worked?

starter_experiment.pilot: Ask ten residents how they dry clothes now, measure drying time, and identify the cost of re-washing or damage.
starter_experiment.test_metric: Drying time, rewashes, garment damage, and willingness to pay
starter_experiment.note: Optional cash ceiling for a first experiment, not money required to begin or a full launch budget. Start with tools and relationships already available; pay partners fairly and account for founder time before scaling.
